text: こらァ　おれたちに　さからうと　いたい　めに　あうぞ！

structure.jp: おれたちに　さからうと
いたい　めに　あうぞ！

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says 'if this happens, that follows for sure'. さからうと = 'if you defy us'.

patterns.name: 〜めにあう
patterns.span: いたい　めに　あう
patterns.explanation: A describing word plus めにあう says you go through that kind of bad experience. いたい　めに　あう = 'have a painful time, get hurt'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, tough-guy speech that pushes a warning onto the listener. あうぞ = 'you'll get it, I tell you!'
